title: PROJECTS · Sales for the month
brief: Total sales for the month ($831,132 in July), change against the same month last year (+67%), and two Top 10 lists — by category and by SKU. Source: cin7_mirror.sales_orders + sale_lines, net of tax. rapid_inv.v_an_monthly_sales already computes month against prior year.

brief: Booked arrivals with ETA, vessel and supplier delivery count. Same origin as slide 6: it exists as a spreadsheet (Container Calendar), not as a table.

title: Monthly Sales by warehouse

title: Stock on Hand by warehouse
brief: Stock value, month sales and months of cover per warehouse. Source: rapid_inv.v_an_stock_by_warehouse. The denominator is COGS, not revenue — revenue inflates cover by the whole margin, the error that reached the deck in April.

title: Stock on Hand · Opening, movement, closing
brief: Opening balance, movements and closing per warehouse. Source: needs movement history, not just the current photo. The mirror holds the snapshot; the movement series has to be built.

title: Ghost Warehouse
brief: In and out of Ghost per branch, in quantity and cost. Source: stock_snapshot holds the Ghost balance (5,072 units today); the in/out flow depends on movement history, like slide 20.

title: Top 10 products low on stock over 6 months
brief: How many times each SKU ran out over the period, with a comment. Source: needs a historical SOH series that is not kept — the mirror is replaced every hour.

title: Faulty Warehouse
brief: Value into Faulty per branch, how much was claimed, and total movement. Source: the Faulty balance is in the mirror (7,057 units); the claimed value comes from warranty, outside it.

title: New Products · Coming
brief: List of new products with an expected date. A commercial decision, typed.
